# neoflowoff.agency

> neoflowoff.agency presents NEO FlowOFF's commercial infrastructure services: AI agents, WhatsApp Business API, CRM, automations, dashboards, landing pages, and paid traffic operations.

This is a public landing and service catalog for agents and humans. Treat the pages below as the canonical public surface for browsing, citation, and summarization. Do not infer private backend behavior, credentials, pricing exceptions, or internal operating procedures from this static site.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/): Overview of the agency, product categories, method, and primary WhatsApp contact route.
- [Sitemap](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/sitemap.xml): XML index of public routes generated for this landing page.
- [Robots Policy](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/robots.txt): Crawler access policy for search and AI agents.

## Plans

- [Agente SDR IA Plug & Play](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/planos/agente-sdr/): AI SDR operation for qualification, routing, and commercial follow-up.
- [Agentes de IA para Operações](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/planos/agents-ia/): AI agents designed around operational roles, integrations, logs, and human escalation.
- [CRM e Operação Comercial](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/planos/crm-inteligente/): CRM structure for pipeline, records, follow-up, and sales visibility.
- [Automações e Fluxos Comerciais](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/planos/fluxos-automacao/): Connected workflows across forms, WhatsApp, CRM, email, data, and APIs.
- [Google Ads para Demanda de Alta Intenção](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/planos/trafego-google/): Google Ads operation focused on high-intent demand and measurable conversion flows.
- [Meta Ads com Server-Side CAPI](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/planos/trafego-meta/): Meta Ads operation with data quality, Pixel, and Conversions API support.

## Services

- [A2M-PoI Standard](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/checkout/a2m-poi-standard/): Public service page for Proof-of-Intention validation and licensing.
- [WhatsApp Business API Oficial](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/checkout/api-whatsapp/): WhatsApp Cloud API implementation with templates, webhooks, and governance.
- [Meta Developers: Apps, APIs e Webhooks](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/checkout/app-meta/): Meta app setup, API permissions, webhook configuration, and compliance support.
- [Dashboards e Gestão de Dados](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/checkout/dashboard-dados/): Dashboards and data organization for commercial visibility.
- [Landing Pages e WebApps Conectados](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/checkout/webapp-lp/): Landing pages and connected web applications for campaigns and operations.

## Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/privacy/): Public privacy policy for Meta, WhatsApp Cloud API, and data governance.
- [Terms of Service](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/legal/): Terms for services, integrations, and Meta platform usage.
- [Data Deletion](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/excluir-dados/): User data deletion instructions for Meta and LGPD compliance.
- [WhatsApp Connection](https://lp.neoflowoff.agency/conectar-whatsapp/): Operational route for WhatsApp connection and Embedded Signup context.

## Ecosystem

- [NEO Protocol](https://neoprotocol.space/): Public protocol context for the broader NEØ ecosystem.
